name: ContractObligationTracker
tagline: Every client contract obligation – owned, evidenced and on time.
description: A complete obligations app for professional services firms: track obligations from client MSAs, SOWs, frameworks and engagement letters with owners, due dates, recurrence, risk and value at risk; collect evidence, route high-risk obligations to reviewers, record breaches and waivers and see the health of every contract – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Review threshold by risk and segregation of duties
Evidence required before completion, with links
Recurring obligations create the next occurrence
Breach and waiver records with reasons
Contract health scores and value at risk
Bulk start, complete, flag and assign
Power Fx outputs and six events
controlType: standard (2 controls: ContractObligationTracker data-set, ContractObligationTrackerPortal field)
